name: title_block_says_the_other_sheets
why: REPORT 8CD843 N59 (round 16, 28/10/2026). «title_block» read only the active sheet. The third sheet of round 16 showed another part, and its title block took two `$PRPSHEET` properties from that part: both empty in the PDF, and the answer, read on the first sheet, said «no empty box».
defect_caught: That a sheet other than the active one shows a model without a property the active sheet shows, and the answer does not say so. Here the first sheet shows «plain», without «Materiale»; the active sheet shows «marked», with it.
_why_two_parts: The warning names only what is empty on the other sheet and NOT on this one: what is empty here too is already in «requested_but_empty» (scenario t60 on a copy of the drawing of round 16: 20 of the 22 names the coupler lacked were empty on the first sheet too, and they buried the two that were not). With one part on both sheets there would be nothing to warn about, so the preparation builds two, and inserts both so that both are open for the views.
_why_no_paper_size: With «paper_size» the sheet has no format notes, so no title block to read: measured on 28/10/2026, the first run of this case was refused with «I cannot find any note in the title block of this sheet». Without it the sheet takes the format of the drawing, as the sheet «Assembly» of two_sheets_and_the_same_projection_angle.

steps._why: create_drawing refuses an active document never saved: measured on 28/10/2026, the second run of this case stopped at create_drawing with «The part has never been saved». bom_counts_the_components saves its assembly the same way.

expect.why: the assembly that holds the two parts open is saved before the drawing
from here on the active document is the drawing
the first sheet shows «plain»: its title block takes `$PRPSHEET` from a part without «Materiale»
the second sheet, active from here on: the first one is now the other sheet
the active sheet shows «marked», which has «Materiale»
the title block read is the one of the active sheet
the active sheet shows «Materiale»: the term of comparison, without which the warning below would prove nothing
the names come from the title block OF THAT SHEET, read from the view of its format without activating it, not from the one of the active sheet

includes: none of them is empty on this sheet
more it lacks are empty on this sheet too
expect.why: THE LINE OF N59: the other sheet is named with the model of its views and the property that model does not have and this sheet shows. The names empty on both sheets are only counted.
asked by the title block and written on neither part: empty on this sheet too, so it is in «requested_but_empty» and not repeated here (scenario t60: such names were 20 of 22)
the verdict speaks for the active sheet, and says so when another sheet has an empty box this one does not have: in round 16 it said «no empty box» of a drawing with one
